0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 13th in the East, 5th in the Central and 2 games back), who are on a two-game losing streak. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), LeBron James (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), and Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 126-106 win in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
